# 🧠 Machine Learning Engineer

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Team:** AI/ML Engineering  
**Experience Level:** Mid to Senior Level

---

## 📌 About the Role

We are looking for a **Machine Learning Engineer** to join our dynamic AI/ML team. You will help design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning systems that power intelligent features and insights for our products. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact by working on cutting-edge models and data pipelines in a collaborative environment.

---

## 💼 Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and optimize machine learning models for production use.
- Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and product managers to define requirements and success metrics.
- Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for training and inference.
- Conduct rigorous model evaluations and performance tuning.
- Stay current with the latest advancements in machine learning and deep learning.
- Own and maintain the ML model lifecycle including versioning, testing, monitoring, and retraining.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

---

## 🛠️ Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, or applied AI.
- Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.
- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
- Experience deploying ML models to production (e.g., using Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud services).
- Familiarity with ML model evaluation, interpretability, and monitoring tools.

---

## ✅ Bonus Points

- Experience with MLOps tools (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, etc.).
- Contributions to open source ML projects.
- Experience with large-scale distributed systems.
- Background in NLP, computer vision, or time series modeling.

---

## 🌟 What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and equity packages.
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
- Generous PTO and flexible work hours.
- Professional development stipend and learning opportunities.
- A supportive team culture that encourages innovation and autonomy.

---

**Join us and help shape the future of intelligent systems.**  
Apply now or reach out to [careers@example.com](mailto:careers@example.com) with any questions.

job_description.rawText:
About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Backend Engineer to join our AI Platform team to build and scale production-ready APIs powered by Gemini, Google’s state-of-the-art multimodal models. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize API services that make AI capabilities accessible, secure, and performant for downstream applications.

You’ll work alongside machine learning engineers, frontend developers, and product managers to bring intelligent features to life, with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and scalability.

⸻

Responsibilities
	•	Design and implement scalable REST and/or gRPC APIs for Gemini-powered features.
	•	Work closely with ML teams to productionize Gemini model calls (e.g., prompt templating, streaming output, retries).
	•	Build and manage asynchronous job pipelines and caching layers to handle long-running or expensive model inference tasks.
	•	Secure APIs with proper authentication/authorization (OAuth2, JWT, API keys).
	•	Write integration and unit tests to ensure reliability and correctness.
	•	Monitor and improve performance using observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana).
	•	Collaborate cross-functionally to define API interfaces and service SLAs.
	•	Ensure the APIs are documented, versioned, and easy to consume.

⸻

Minimum Qualifications
	•	3+ years of experience building backend services in Python, Go, Java, or similar.
	•	Proficiency in designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services.
	•	Experience with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS).
	•	Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
	•	Strong understanding of API security best practices and performance tuning.
	•	Comfort working with large-scale data or model outputs (e.g., token streaming, pagination, rate limits).

⸻

Preferred Qualifications
	•	Experience integrating with large language models (LLMs) or generative AI APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude).
	•	Exposure to vector stores, embedding pipelines, or RAG systems.
	•	Familiarity with API gateways (e.g., Kong, Apigee) and traffic management.
	•	Knowledge of FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent modern Python frameworks.
	•	Contributions to open-source AI or API tooling.
